# ADR-3261: AWS root_mfa: Prefer hardware MFA for root user 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Virtual MFA can be cloned with the phone.

## Decision

Security teams SHOULD prefer hardware MFA for root user 5 (AWS-root_mfa-5) when protecting high-value accounts.

## Consequences

Hardware tokens are dual-custodied.
